text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll show them whose pranks are stale!
This next
prank's gonna blow their socks
off!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Or that was the plan, anyway, but I'm
outta good
ideas. I've pulled off
practically every prank
under the sun
already...

text_block_list.name: Dancing Passersby
text_block_list.text:
La, la, la! ♪ It's the day that only comes
once a
year! ♪ That's right—it's your
birthday, so give us
a cheer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Dancing Passersby
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday to you. ♪ Happy
memories to
you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what the heck is going on?! Why did
all those
people start dancing outta
nowhere?!

text_block_list.name: Surprised Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Is this what they call a flash mob?
I've seen
them before on TV!

text_block_list.name: Surprised Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
They just started dancing out of the
blue—that
really caught me off guard! I
won't be forgetting
this for a while!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Th-this is it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I picked the prettiest flowers to
make this
crown! If I dance with it on, I'll
grab everyone's
attention for sure!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what a beautiful flower crown! Do
you mind
if I take a closer look?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's not the part you're supposed
to focus
on!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hyah, hyah, hi-yah! ♪ Feast your eyes
on these
slick moves!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I've never seen a technique like
that. It
must be a new style of martial
art.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It looks like a lotta fun! Makes me want
to learn
the kata and try it out myself!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This mysterious, glowing rock I found
near
Tachyon's lab will definitely get a
reaction outta
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now, mysterious rock! Absorb the
brightness from
the stage lights and
make me shine! Super Sparkle
Windy,
activate!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, such a magnificent solo
performance! Even I,
the Centurial
Overlord, was captivated by its

brilliance! It seems a rising star is among
us!
Bravo!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! Why did Windy's ears and tail
droop like
that? Did something bad
happen?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hm. Based on my analysis, Windy's eyes
are
currently filled with impatience,
confusion... and
sadness. This is
definitely cause for concern.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Aw, man. They reacted the same way
as they
did to all the other pranks. None
of this is going
right.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, no! No getting cold feet, Windy!
My next
surprise is gonna blow their
minds for sure!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you, Windy. Are you cheering
for
someone?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What's up, girlie? Hey, what's wrong?
Why's your
dance all "Wahey!" while
your face is all "No
way!"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So you want to come up with a new way
to
surprise people that doesn't feel
stale?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I've tried a buncha things,
but
nothing's working!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh! At this rate, Hishiama and
everyone'll
keep treatin' me like one big
joke!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Wouldn't it be easier to pull off
something
big if you had more people?
Like that flash mob
you saw.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So true! The bigger the crowd, the
wilder the
vibes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
For starters, get some people together!
You can
count me in—I love this kind of
stuff.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I totally relate! Besties plus good times
equals
lifelong memories, preach it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: R-really?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Then it's settled! You can join me as my
minions!
Spread the magnificence of
Windy far and wide!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Bet! And hey, you two over there!
What's with the
stakeout? Come join us!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Aargh?! They spotted us!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I am a bajillion percent not worthy to
be in the
presence of my oshis, but if
you think I can help,
I'll work myself
down to the bone!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Me too... I don't really know what we're
doing,
but if it'll cheer Windy up, I'd be
happy to help.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look how many of you there are
now! Way
to go, me! I'm just too
charismatic for my own
good!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now, nothing is stopping me from
scaring the
living daylights outta
everyone! Let's do this
thing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sight of Shinko Windy happily
putting a plan
together with her friends
is heartwarming—even if
they're up to no
good.
